text: The director of sales wants to make sure that every opportunity has either a sales engineer or an account executive assigned to the deal. How should the administrator meet this requirement?
options: Write a validation rule that checks if the fields are blank and require that one of them is completed in order to save the opportunity.
Create a different record type for deals with Sales Engineers and deals with Account Executives to capture one or the other.
Require the Sales Engineer and the Account Executive lookup fields on the page layout.
Assign a task to the owner if an opportunity is created without one of these fields filled out.
explanation: A validation rule enforces data quality by preventing users from saving records that do not meet certain criteria.

text: AW Computing is running a special bundle deal on monitors and keyboards. Normally, discounts need VP approval, but this special bundle is pre-approved. What should the administrator recommend for these requirements?
explanation: Implementing CPQ or configuring specialized pricing logic allows structured bundle discounting without triggering standard VP approval processes.

text: Dream House Realty currently deals only with single-family homes but is expanding its business to include condos in large cities. There are some features and amenities that only apply to condos. How should an administrator configure the Opportunity object to ensure that only relevant fields are displayed on the record?
options: Build a Lightning component to display fields that only apply to condos.
Create a Record Type for the type of property and custom page layouts for each.
Configure a validation rule to display fields based on the type of property the user is viewing.
Make a custom Lightning page to display specific fields based on the type of property.
explanation: Record Types paired with custom page layouts allow displaying specific fields relevant to each business process or property type.

text: At Ursa Major Solar, there is a custom object called Galaxy. The sales director wants users to only see certain fields. What Lightning component will satisfy this requirement?
explanation: The Fields component in Lightning App Builder allows administrators to render dynamic individual fields on a record page based on conditional visibility.

text: An administrator has been asked to enable permissions for users on the account services team to be able to edit and change ownership of Accounts owned by any of the team members. What should the administrator configure?
options: Set organization-wide sharing for Account as Public Read Only.
Create a Sharing Rule on the Account object for all members of the account services role to have Read/Write access.
Update the profile Account object to Modify All.
Enable Account Teams and grant Read record-level access to account team members for the Account object.
explanation: Creating a Read/Write Sharing Rule for members of the account services role allows them to edit and transfer ownership of Accounts owned by peers.

text: AW Computing has a private sharing model for its accounts, but a sales rep occasionally needs assistance from an engineer. What feature should be used to grant the engineer access to the necessary account, while maintaining data security?
explanation: Account Teams allow users to grant ad-hoc record-level access to collaborators on specific accounts.

text: Ursa Major Solar allows its scientists to log new stars, but occasionally they log duplicates. The administrator wants scientists to be notified when a record is deleted and by whom. What automation solution should be used?
explanation: Record-triggered Flows running on record deletion can send email notifications and capture deletion context.

text: The administrator at Cloud Kicks has been requested to provide access to the Leads object to a contractor. The contractor should only have View access to all of the Lead records. How should the administrator handle this request?
options: Assign a permission set that has View All on Leads.
Add an app with the Leads tab to the user's profile.
Assign the contractor a public group with Lead access.
Create a profile with Read Only for all Leads.
explanation: Permission sets give users additional permissions (such as View All on Leads) without altering their baseline profile.

text: Cloud Kicks deployed custom apps using Lightning Web components. Which tool should the administrator use to expose possible security risks?
explanation: Salesforce Health Check evaluates security settings against recommended baselines to expose vulnerabilities.

text: Northern Trail Outfitters is expanding into the U.K. While most products are the same as in the US, pricing varies due to shipping and material costs. What should the administrator configure?
options: Configure a U.K. Opportunity record type.
Write a flow that translates currency using a custom exchange rate field.
Add a new U.K. Order Form with the Euro symbol.
Create a new Price Book for the U.K. product pricing.
explanation: Price Books store distinct product prices tailored to specific regional markets or currencies.

text: AW Computing wants to create a process to assign accounts to different salespeople based on annual revenue. Which two considerations apply when creating the flow?
options: Use a Get Record component instead of hard coding record IDs.
The running user is the user that last saved the flow.
Update record elements should be placed outside the flow loop.
Update record elements should be placed inside the flow loop.
explanation: Use Get Records to dynamically fetch IDs and place DML updates outside loops to prevent hitting governor limits.

text: An administrator is planning the release process using change sets to process deployment to production. Which three best practices should be considered?
options: Plan your deployments around the production and sandbox maintenance schedules.
Use matching names for global publisher layouts and Outlook publisher layouts.
Be sure to test only after business hours.
Make sure to deploy all dependent components.
Make sure change sets are limited to 10,000 files.
explanation: Align deployments with maintenance schedules, include all dependencies, and respect the 10,000 file limit.

text: Cloud Kicks received feedback that customers wait too long to reach a support agent by area of expertise. Which feature should the administrator configure?
explanation: Omni-Channel routes work items to agents based on skills, availability, and capacity.

text: DreamHouse Realty uses a Roll-up Summary and Flow on appointments. What consideration about process automation should the administrator be aware of?
options: Only standard objects can be used with Roll-up Summary fields.
Flows can only be triggered from standard objects.
Roll-up Summary calculations prevent Flow execution.
Roll-up Summary calculations run after processes and workflows.
explanation: Roll-up summary calculations are executed after workflow and process automation triggers.

text: Production deployment failed after full sandbox success. Where should the administrator check to see what was recently changed in production?
explanation: Setup Audit Trail tracks administrative and configuration changes made in Setup.

text: Moving flows with a change set. Which three considerations apply?
options: Flows deployed are inactive and need to be manually activated.
Flow allows only one version when deployed.
Deploying or redeploying a flow creates a version in destination org.
All flow dependencies are automatically added.
Flows are automatically activated upon deployment.
explanation: Flows deploy inactive, create new versions upon deployment, and dependencies are automatically added.

text: Screen flow errors in production when creating records. How to debug?
options: Change user to System Administrator profile.
Open flow in Debug mode and Run as another user.
Log in as user and run flow.
explanation: Debugging a flow as a specific user in Flow Builder identifies profile or permission issues.

text: Cloud Kicks offers 6 months phone support on custom sneakers. What feature helps manage this?
options: Use Flow to automatically assign entitlements.
Set up and configure entitlement templates.
explanation: Entitlement templates automatically attach support terms when products are added to records.

text: Select power users want configuration access to a custom object without full admin access. What should be assigned?
explanation: Delegated Administration delegates specific object and user administration rights.

text: Service reps cannot find relevant Knowledge articles due to search clutter. What should be implemented?
options: Delete and remove old Knowledge articles.
Update Knowledge to auto-search case subject.
explanation: Data Categories organize Knowledge content into hierarchical categories for filtering.

text: Users get logged out of Salesforce without notice due to session timeouts. What should be adjusted?
options: Deselect disable session timeout warning popup.
Select force logout on session timeout.
explanation: Deselecting disable session timeout warning popup displays an alert before session expiration.

text: Create Contract button should only appear when opportunity reaches Negotiation stage. How to implement?
explanation: Dynamic Actions allow conditionally showing action buttons on Lightning record pages.

text: Applicants can apply for multiple Job Postings and each Job Posting can have multiple Applicants. How to configure?
options: Junction object with master-detail to Applications and lookup to Job Posting.
Junction object with master-detail to Job Postings and lookup to Job Applications.
Job Application as junction object with master-detail to both Application and Job Postings.
explanation: A junction object requires two master-detail relationships to model many-to-many relationships.

text: When should an administrator apply a permission set instead of changing a user profile?
options: User needs less access than team.
User needs additional specific permissions beyond baseline team profile.
Org opted out of standard profiles.
explanation: Permission sets grant additional permissions to specific users without altering their baseline profile.

text: Two record-triggered flows on same object conflict and leave child field null. How to resolve?
options: Combine into a single flow with decision logic.
explanation: Combining flows on the same object into one ensures deterministic execution order.

text: Migrating updated profiles and a new app from sandbox to production. Which two options to use?
explanation: Outbound Change Sets are uploaded from the source org and deployed as Inbound Change Sets in the target org.

text: Testing a flow containing a Delete Records element. What consideration applies?
options: Debugging the flow will delete the test record even if inactive.
explanation: Debugging a flow executes real database operations including record creation and deletion.

text: Before deploying a change set with field and layout edits to production, what should be done?
options: Push change set to another sandbox to test validation.
explanation: Testing deployment in a staging sandbox validates dependencies and prevents production errors.

text: Account object tracks customers and competitors with different required fields. What feature to use?
explanation: Record Types allow presenting tailored page layouts and picklists per business record type.

text: Sales team wants quick access to a daily dashboard. What should the admin recommend?
options: Add dashboard to Sales team home page.
explanation: Embedding dashboard components on the Home page provides immediate daily visibility upon login.

text: Users complain about clutter from irrelevant page actions. What should the admin recommend?
options: Use Dynamic Actions and conditional visibility.
explanation: Dynamic Actions display action buttons conditionally based on record fields or user context.

text: SLA guarantee requires cases to be prioritized and assigned quickly. What feature to use?
explanation: Case Assignment Rules automatically route incoming cases to designated queues or reps.

text: Remote user cannot log in. What is the most likely cause?
options: User IP address is outside profile IP ranges
explanation: Enforced Login IP Ranges on profiles block login attempts from unauthorized IP addresses.

text: Admin wants to see how many users logged in with Salesforce Authenticator. Which two methods?
options: Create a new view in Identity Verification History, specifying Method.
Export Login History and filter based off Authentication Method Reference.
explanation: Identity Verification History and exported Login History contain authentication method details.

text: B2C company wants to track third-party financial advisors and customer relationships. How to configure?
options: Set up Contacts to Multiple Accounts for loan advisors.
explanation: Contacts to Multiple Accounts connects a contact to multiple account records with specific roles.

text: Which two tools review Lightning record page performance?
explanation: The Analyze button in Lightning App Builder and Lightning Usage App measure page load times.

text: Web lead form causes errors when reps edit leads after picklist updates. What tool evaluates the cause?
explanation: Debug Logs detail execution errors, trigger failures, and validation rule evaluation steps.

text: Product team wants to group picklist values into two categories in a report without changing data. What to use?
explanation: Bucket fields group report values into custom categories without altering underlying records.

text: Sales team captures preferences in spreadsheets and wants it in Salesforce. Which two configuration methods?
explanation: Lightning Object Creator converts spreadsheets into objects, and Data Loader imports records.

text: Sales agents occasionally import ~100 records for a custom object. Which tool should they use?
explanation: Data Import Wizard is a simple in-browser tool for non-technical users importing up to 50,000 records.

text: Security wants System Administrators to have a 15-character minimum password with 30-day expiration. Where to configure?
options: Password Policies on System Administrator profile
explanation: Profile-level Password Policies override org-wide defaults for specific admin profiles.

text: Force users to set 'Tier' by answering questions without bypassing. Which two functions?
options: Make field Read Only on page layout
Use screen flow to ask questions
explanation: Making the field Read-Only prevents manual entry, while a Screen Flow guides input and sets the value.

text: Ensure sales reps enter zip codes in hyphenated format. What to implement?
explanation: Validation rules using REGEX enforce strict pattern formatting requirements.

text: Auto-response rule sends email based on Case Source. Process Builder sets Case Source on Email-to-Case. What happens?
options: Case Source updates to 'email' and email is sent using Template2.
Email sent using Template then Case Source updates.
Email sent using Template2 then Case Source updates.
Case Source updates to 'email' then email sent using Template1.
explanation: Record-triggered automation updates the record before auto-response rules evaluate criteria.

text: Bulk API delete in Data Loader gives 'entity is deleted' error for every row. What is the cause?
options: Bulk API only supports Batch API mode
One or more IDs in batch refer to records already in recycle bin
explanation: Attempting to delete record IDs that already reside in the Recycle Bin causes 'entity is deleted' errors.

text: Apex trigger execution needs to be controlled declaratively per user. What requirement should be requested?
options: Custom permission assigned via permission set
explanation: Custom Permissions can be checked in Apex code ($Permission.Name) to declaratively gate execution.

text: Check 'Opportunity Created' checkbox on Account when an opportunity is created. What feature to use?
explanation: Record-triggered flows running after save on Opportunity creation can update parent Account fields.

text: New validation rule created directly in production caused deployment tests to fail. How to prevent this conflict?
options: Test changes in a shared sandbox environment
explanation: Building and validating all changes in a shared sandbox pipeline prevents deployment conflicts.

text: Installing an AppExchange managed package. Which three considerations apply?
options: Custom objects/fields count against org limits
Apps may require specific editions/features enabled
Apps may require external third-party web services
explanation: Managed packages consume object/field limits, may require edition features, and might rely on third-party web APIs.

text: Configuring Product Schedules. What consideration applies?
options: Line Item Schedule is unavailable in Process Builder and Workflow
explanation: Line Item Schedules have limited automation support in legacy Workflow Rules and Process Builder.

text: Users prompted for verification when exporting reports. What causes this?
options: Exporting configured to require High Assurance session
explanation: High Assurance session requirements in Session Security Settings mandate MFA for report exports.

text: After implementing MFA, users are unable to log in. What should the administrator troubleshoot?
options: Check session security level required at login on user profile
explanation: Profile 'Session Security Level Required at Login' dictates whether standard MFA satisfies login requirements.

text: Private OWD on Accounts. Managers need to see all Accounts. What should the admin configure?
options: Permission Set with View All on Accounts assigned to managers
explanation: A Permission Set with 'View All' on Accounts grants full account visibility without changing OWD or profiles.

text: Hide 'Profit' field on Opportunity from Partners using FLS. Which two features to use?
explanation: Field-Level Security (FLS) is managed via Profiles and Permission Sets.

text: Calculate YoY percentage change in opportunity dollar amounts grouped by year. Which tool to use?
options: Custom summary formula with PREVGROUPVAL function
explanation: PREVGROUPVAL evaluates summary values from a previous display grouping (such as prior calendar year).

text: Prevent duplicate Contacts in Salesforce. Which two features to customize?
explanation: Duplicate Management uses Matching Rules (to identify duplicates) and Duplicate Rules (to enforce actions).

text: Improve customer search for Knowledge articles. Which two changes to make?
options: Promote specific search terms for specific articles
explanation: Synonyms match equivalent terms, and Promoted Search Terms boost specific article rankings.

text: Which two functions can a Delegated Administrator perform?
options: Set up users and password management
explanation: Delegated Admins can manage users, reset passwords, and manage specified user roles/groups.

text: Import over 100,000 historical records from another system. How to import?
options: Data Loader with Bulk API Enabled
explanation: Data Loader utilizing the Bulk API is optimized for processing datasets exceeding 50,000 records.

text: Automate updates to Lead records and update unrelated records on create/update. Which two tools?
options: Flow running when record is created or updated
explanation: Record-triggered Flows and Process Builder can update triggering records and navigate to update unrelated records.

text: An administrator needs to create a junction object called Account Region to link Account with custom object Region. What two steps should be taken once created?
options: Make a master-detail relationship field on junction object to Region
Build master-detail on Region to junction
Create master-detail on Account to junction
Configure master-detail relationship field on junction object to Account
explanation: A junction object requires two master-detail relationships pointing to the respective parent objects.

text: An administrator is deploying a change set from an upgraded sandbox to a destination org on a previous release. Metadata fails. What should be done?
options: Make changes manually in source org
Create a new sandbox on the new release version and deploy change set there
explanation: Deployments between differing release versions require matching API/release version sandboxes.

text: Annual service contract expiration date changes from next year to yesterday in a record-triggered flow with scheduled paths. What occurs?
options: Flow error is sent to initiator
Interview resumes 1 month before original expiration
Interview rescheduled to end of month
The resume event is recalculated and the email goes out immediately
explanation: When date evaluation criteria fall in the past upon record edit, scheduled paths recalculate and trigger immediately.

text: Admin soft launched Salesforce Authenticator and wants to see user adoption. Which two ways to get this information?
options: Run session setting report specifying login methods by user
Open Login Access Policies in Setup
Create a new view in Identity Verification History, specifying Method
Export Login History and filter based off Authentication Method Reference
explanation: Identity Verification History and exported Login History provide granular authentication logs.

text: What should the administrator consider before enabling Person Accounts?
options: Person Accounts cannot be disabled once enabled
Person Accounts and Business Accounts cannot be in same sharing model
explanation: Enabling Person Accounts is an irreversible setting in Salesforce orgs.

text: Which two tools should an administrator use to require data entry in a field and improve record data quality?
explanation: Validation Rules enforce data integrity server-side, and Page Layouts make fields required on user interfaces.

text: After setting up field history tracking on Account, how should the admin retrieve the field history data for analysis?
options: Create report of Accounts and export to Excel
Query and export the Account History object using Data Loader
Use Data export service in setup
Create list view of Account History
explanation: Field history tracking data is stored in the AccountHistory object and can be exported via Data Loader / SOQL.

text: A sales user is assigned to a permission set group giving Modify All on Accounts, and assigned a muting permission set that mutes Delete on Account. What access level remains?
explanation: Muting permission sets remove specific object permissions (Delete) while retaining other granted permissions.

text: A custom field 'Government ID' is encrypted using Classic Encryption. How will this impact users when reading/editing/reporting?
options: Encrypted fields are unable to be used in report criteria or list view filters
Users need View Encrypted Data to edit
Encrypted fields can be added to list views
Users with View Encrypted Data bypass FLS
explanation: Classic Encrypted fields cannot be used in report filters, list view filters, or formula fields.

text: DreamHouse Realty has Rental and Real Estate teams with different sales processes and field needs. How to extend Opportunity object?
options: Create custom object for Rental team
Use separate record types, page layouts, and sales processes for Rental and Real Estate teams
Add sections on Master record type
explanation: Record Types combined with Page Layouts and Sales Processes isolate unique team workflows.

text: The Cloud Kicks administrator wants to open up opportunity sharing to directors who oversee regional managers so they can access records to assist regional managers. What sharing mechanism should be used?
explanation: Role Hierarchy grants access to records owned by or shared with users below them in the hierarchy.

text: An administrator created a new custom object. When trying to upload new records using Data Loader, they are unable to see the object in the list. What should be done?
options: Confirm object is marked as Deployed and not in Development
explanation: Custom objects in 'In Development' status are hidden from non-admin API tools until set to 'Deployed'.

text: Cloud Kicks backup team works across multiple departments. How to ensure they view Lightning record pages relevant to each department?
options: Configure one app per department and activate record pages for each app
explanation: Lighting record pages can be activated at the App level to adapt UI based on active app context.

text: DreamHouse Realty has a master-detail relationship from Open Houses to Properties. How to count Pending Open Houses on Property?
explanation: Roll-Up Summary fields on master objects perform aggregate calculations (COUNT/SUM) on child detail records.

text: Users report industry picklist is no longer visible on Accounts. What tool troubleshooting tool tracks who changed it?
explanation: Setup Audit Trail tracks recent administrative configuration changes made across Setup.

text: Embed a report chart on Account page showing closed sales value, restricted only to Sales Manager role. How to accomplish?
options: Filter component visibility for Account ID
Filter component visibility for Sales Manager role
explanation: Lightning App Builder component visibility filters restrict component rendering by user role/profile.

text: What should an administrator use as an alternative to Process Builder to expedite record update execution time?
explanation: Before-save record-triggered flows update triggering records in memory prior to database save, executing significantly faster.

text: How to ensure the exact 16-digit length in a custom encrypted credit card field on Opportunity?
options: Create a validation rule to ensure length
explanation: Validation rules enforce precise character length criteria on encrypted text fields.

text: Troubleshooting Process Builder execution in Dev Console Log Inspector. What event type to filter in the event column?
explanation: Process Builder execution logs under the FLOW event namespace in Salesforce debug logs.

text: Salesforce user unable to log in via MFA. Which two areas should the administrator review for root cause?
explanation: Identity Verification History and Login History provide detailed failure reasons for MFA verification.

text: Sales reps want to quickly close opportunities to 'Closed Won' on Salesforce Mobile. What to create?
explanation: Object-specific Quick Actions allow predefined field values for fast execution on mobile record pages.

text: Contact phone numbers revert to old values after updates. What should the administrator do?
explanation: Conflicting redundant automation tools updating the same object cause race conditions and overwrite values.

text: Contacts to Multiple Accounts is enabled. Rep cannot remove primary account from contact. Why?
options: Primary Account relationship is required on Contact regardless of layout settings
Account Contact relationship record must be deleted first
explanation: The direct Primary Account relationship is mandatory on Contact records even when shared contacts are enabled.

text: Changing record type via Screen Flow on Account. What happens to user's record access?
explanation: Record Types control UI display and picklists; record access security is governed by OWD, roles, and sharing.

text: Replaced case workflow rules with before-save flow. Routing behavior changed. What caused this?
options: Flow precedes assignment rules; workflow rules run after assignment rules
explanation: Before-save flows run before Assignment Rules, modifying field values before evaluation, whereas workflows run after.

text: Junction object connects Docs with Solar Panels. What access level is needed to see junction records?
options: Read permission required on both master records
Read permission required on at least one master record
explanation: Viewing a junction record requires Read access on at least one of the parent master records and the junction object itself.

text: Cloud Kicks wants to back up data daily. What should the administrator recommend?
options: Use an ETL tool scheduled to extract data
explanation: ETL tools (like Data Loader CLI or third-party backup solutions) support automated daily data extraction schedules.

text: Show Lead Source effectiveness per Country in a grouped report where lead counts vary greatly. What to use?
explanation: PARENTGROUPVAL calculates proportions/percentages against parent subtotal groupings in reports.

text: Apex developer cannot see debug info for platform event flow execution. What should the admin recommend?
options: Select Debug Enabled on platform events
Set a debug log on the Automated Process entity
explanation: Automated system events and platform event flows execute under the 'Automated Process' system user context.

text: Customer should automatically receive phone support when purchasing photo editing software. How to configure?
options: Flow to create milestone on asset
Create a flow to attach an entitlement to the asset upon purchase
explanation: Record-triggered flows can automatically instantiate and link Entitlements when assets/products are created.

text: Employee resigned immediately. Sole owner of 4,000 records and email alerts. What immediate action to take?
explanation: Freezing a user immediately revokes login access without breaking active workflows, record ownership, or email alerts.

text: Send listing price update messages to external endpoint upon approval. What automation tool to use?
explanation: Flow supports HTTP Callouts and External Services to integrate with third-party Web endpoints declaratively.

text: User with Read/Write on Accounts and owner of both records cannot merge them. What permission is missing?
explanation: Merging records requires the Delete object permission because duplicate records are removed during the merge.

text: Record page loading slowly due to excessive components and fields. What three options help optimize performance?
options: Move some page components behind a tab
Remove some of the fields displayed
Reduce the number of related lists displayed
explanation: Moving components behind tabs, reducing displayed fields, and limiting related lists reduce initial DOM render load.

text: Process Builder does not trigger on field update from Approval Process. What should be checked?
options: Check 'Reevaluate Workflow Rules After Field Change' on Field Update Action
Turn Recursion on in Process Builder
explanation: Reevaluate Workflow Rules After Field Change forces re-triggering of automation rules following an approval field update.

text: Data being saved violates validation rules during automated procedure. Why?
options: Field is being updated by a workflow field update
explanation: Workflow Field Updates bypass validation rules during execution.

text: Sales rep has opportunities but is missing from manager's forecast. What to enable on user record?
explanation: The 'Allow Forecasting' checkbox on the User record enables forecasting rollup participation.

text: Compliance team wants a report showing field-level sensitivity and classification data. What to recommend?
options: Run the standard Data Classification report
Use Data Classification Metadata list view
Configure custom Data Classification report type
explanation: Salesforce provides a standard Data Classification report detailing field sensitivity levels.

text: Support staff switching between tabs repeatedly when handling accounts/cases. What to implement?
explanation: Service Console provides a tabbed workspace interface allowing agents to work multiple related records simultaneously.

text: Troubleshooting a flow issue for a specific user using debug logs. What log category to select?
explanation: The 'Workflow' log category captures Flow, Process Builder, and Workflow Rule execution steps.

text: Enabling Advanced Currency Management. Which two considerations apply?
options: Historical trend reports use last exchange rate
Advanced Currency Management cannot be disabled once enabled
explanation: Added currencies cannot be removed and Advanced Currency Management enablement is permanent.

text: Marketing profile needs full access to Membership Details, Support profile needs access only to Support fields, both need reporting access. How to deliver?
options: Two record types and page layouts
Use Field-Level Security to control data access
explanation: FLS controls field visibility across UI and reports without restricting object-level reporting capabilities.

text: Changing lookup to master-detail on Potential Name to Product Development. How to handle blank lookup records?
options: Move Potential Name records with blank lookup to recycle bin
Assign Potential Name records with blank lookup to an existing Product Development record
explanation: Converting lookup to master-detail requires all existing records to have populated parent lookup values.

text: Compliance team wants to flag where sensitive information is stored in Salesforce. What feature to use?
explanation: Data Classification categorizes fields by data sensitivity and compliance requirements.

text: Forecast numbers by territory regardless of owner, plus role hierarchy forecasting. Which three recommendations?
options: Select forecast type under Display Settings
explanation: Enabling Territory Forecasts and Role Hierarchy Forecasts satisfies multi-dimensional pipeline forecasting.

text: Match existing and add new leads from 5,000 lead file with External ID and Status using Data Loader. What action?
explanation: Upsert uses External IDs to update existing matching records and insert new ones in a single batch operation.

text: Company manages B2C individual buyers and B2B customer employees under accounts. Which two features needed?
explanation: Person Accounts model B2C customers while Contacts to Multiple Accounts relates individuals to corporate entities.

text: Multiple record-triggered flows configured on Account for create/update. What consideration applies to execution order?
options: The order in which those flows are executed is not guaranteed
explanation: Execution order across multiple record-triggered flows on the same event is non-deterministic unless flow trigger ordering is defined.

text: Sales reps need customized field presentation on new logo opportunity details page. Where to edit fields displayed?
explanation: Page Layouts define field arrangement, sections, and basic field requirements on record pages.

text: Show current Account status on Case record and use in Case validation rules. What to implement?
options: Add a lookup field to Account
explanation: Cross-object formula fields reference parent fields on child records for UI display and validation logic.

text: Create 'Next Steps' field on Lead with text formatting mapped to Opportunity on conversion. What field type?
explanation: Rich Text Area fields support formatted text and map cleanly to Rich Text fields on Opportunity during Lead conversion.

text: Enable backup resource to assign permissions without allowing creation/modification of permission sets. What feature?
explanation: Delegated Administration permits specific users to assign designated permission sets without modifying setup definitions.

text: Production Process Builder causing error messages on Account updates. Which three steps to take?
options: Review Error Email for Process Builder
Fix Process Builder in sandbox and migrate
explanation: Analyzing error emails, deactivating failing production processes, and deploying sandbox fixes resolves deployment failures.

text: New administrator cannot use outbound change sets. Which permission should be checked?
explanation: The 'Create and Upload Change Sets' system permission enables creation and deployment of outbound change sets.

text: Expose legacy application inventory data in Salesforce for viewing and reporting without storing locally. What action?
options: Create an external object that maps to the inventory application
Import data into custom object temporarily
explanation: External Objects (via Salesforce Connect) render real-time external database data natively in Salesforce.

text: Private sharing model on credit info records. Visible to sales rep's manager, hidden from peers. How to adjust?
options: Add View All via manager profile
Create sharing rules for each manager based on record owner
Grant access using hierarchies via sharing settings
explanation: Grant Access Using Hierarchies ensures managers automatically inherit access to subordinates' records while hiding from peers.

text: Sales rep broke phone with Salesforce Authenticator app and needs immediate opportunity access. What action?
options: Generate a temporary identity verification code for the rep
explanation: Administrators can generate temporary verification codes in Setup to bypass lost MFA authenticators.

text: Finance team wants pipeline overview and anticipated income by quarter without manual calculations. What feature?
explanation: Collaborative Forecasting aggregates open pipeline data against target quotas automatically.

text: Training sandbox with 160MB test data needing refresh every 2 days. Which two sandbox types to select?
explanation: Developer Pro (1GB limit, daily refresh) and Partial Copy (10GB limit) accommodate 160MB test data requirements.

text: When should an administrator consider implementing Person Accounts?
options: Complex B2B model where opportunities are on contacts
B2B model selling to primary contacts
In a B2C business model and the consumer is the intended recipient of sales and marketing attention
Need separate Contact and Account on Cases
explanation: Person Accounts are specifically designed for B2C models where individual clients represent both account and contact.

text: Protect reports and dashboards against phishing and ensure logged-in user identity during export/printing. What action?
options: Require a high assurance session when exporting or printing reports and dashboards
explanation: Requiring High Assurance session security on report export forces step-up authentication prior to data downloading.

text: Account OWD is Public Read Only, Contacts are Controlled by Parent. Sales manager owns contact. Who can edit?
options: Users above sales manager in hierarchy
explanation: The record owner and System Administrator retain edit rights when parent account is Read Only.

text: Automate renewal opportunity creation for service plans based on closed-won date and line items. What approach?
options: Configure a flow that will create the renewal based on the closed-won date and opportunity line items
explanation: Record-triggered Flows automate complex child record generation (like renewals) upon Opportunity closure.

text: Sales reps viewing initial screen after clicking finish in Screen Flow. How to fix?
options: Update the flow with a local redirect action
explanation: Local redirect actions or setting navigate-to-record options prevent flow loops upon completion.

text: Customer record pages loading slowly due to high field and component counts. What tool diagnose improvements?
options: Click Analyze from the Lightning App Builder toolbar
Review debug logs in Dev Console
explanation: The 'Analyze' tool in Lightning App Builder measures performance impact per component and field layout.

text: Import a batch of person accounts into Salesforce. What tool to use?
explanation: Data Import Wizard natively supports importing Person Accounts up to 50,000 records.

text: Multiple before-save record-triggered flows activated on same object. What consideration applies?
options: The order of flow execution is unpredictable
explanation: Before-save flows execute in non-deterministic order unless specific flow trigger order numbers are configured.

text: Display dynamic action buttons on Planet object based on whether planet is gaseous. Which component?
explanation: Dynamic Actions configured on the Highlights Panel component show or hide action buttons based on record field rules.

text: Route leads based on planet and enforce specific fields for Jupiter leads. Which two features satisfy this?
explanation: Lead Assignment Rules route records to teams, while Validation Rules enforce conditional field population.

text: Audit external public sharing configurations across all objects quickly. Which tool to use?
explanation: Security Health Check scans OWD and sharing settings against recommended security baselines.

text: Restrict exporting sensitive data (bank accounts, PII). Which feature to recommend?
explanation: Salesforce Shield (specifically Event Monitoring) allows detecting and blocking high-volume data export attempts.

text: Two best practices when configuring change sets for production deployment. Choose 2 answers?
options: Clone change set to add forgotten dependencies
Add permissions and access settings to outbound change sets in addition to dependent components
Run deployment validations on change set in sandbox prior to uploading to production
explanation: Including profile permissions/FLS and running pre-deployment validation tests ensure change set success.

text: Organization reached hourly limit processing workflow time triggers. Which two items to review?
explanation: Time-Based Workflow queues and Debug Logs detail pending and executed time trigger actions.

text: Duplicate warnings appearing for common contact names. How to improve user experience while preserving data integrity?
options: Include the Email field to the existing matching rule for a more exact match
explanation: Adding Email to matching criteria narrows duplicate detection precision without disabling enforcement.

text: One user encounters flow error while processing records; peers with same access succeed. How to troubleshoot?
options: Use flow debug option and set selection to Run as another user
Run flow in System Context Without Sharing
explanation: Flow Builder Debug mode with 'Run as another user' reproduces permission and context issues specific to a individual.

text: Two users with same profile and subordinate role. Only one can view account owned by manager. Why?
explanation: Manual sharing grants individual record access exceptions overriding standard role hierarchy access.

text: Assign task due date based on furthest date between Shipping Date and Client Need By Date. Which two tools?
options: Create a formula to capture MAX date
Make a Process Builder to create the task
explanation: A formula field using MAX() calculates the target date, and automation creates the task using that formula value.

text: Distributor account information is sensitive and must be obscured in full sandbox. What tool to use?
explanation: Salesforce Data Mask automatically anonymizes sensitive production data during sandbox refreshes.

text: Reduce file size of full data exports for faster completion. Which three recommendations?
options: Reduce amount of objects per export
Deselect 'Include images, documents, and attachments' in export
Keep deleted record counts to a minimum
explanation: Excluding unneeded objects, unchecking heavy attachments, and purging deleted records reduces export payload.

text: Change set 1 has objects/fields, Change set 2 has profiles/automation. What to consider before deployment?
options: Field-Level Security will not be deployed with profiles in change set 2 unless fields are present
Automations must be in same set
explanation: Profile FLS settings deploy only for custom fields contained within the same change set package.

text: Keep secure fields protected in email templates. What action should be taken?
options: Remove the fields from the email
explanation: Classic Encrypted fields mask values in UI and prevent unauthorized exposure in outgoing automated templates.

text: Users missing automated email alerts because daily outbound email limits were hit. Where to review?
explanation: Email Logs detail outbound message volume, delivery errors, and daily limit threshold breaches.

text: Deactivated consultant still receives email fault alerts from failed flows. How to stop these emails?
options: Set 'Send Process or Flow Error Email' to 'Apex Exception Email Recipients' in Automation settings
explanation: Configuring Automation Settings to send error emails to Apex Exception Email Recipients redirects fault alerts to admins.

text: Divisions with high turnover want to manage users independently within their division. What to set up?
options: Set up delegated administrators for division leaders
explanation: Delegated Administration permits designated division managers to create and manage users within specified roles.

text: User inactive this quarter missing from Identity Verification History. Which two reasons explain why?
options: Up to 20,000 records of users' identity verification attempts are stored
The last 6 months worth of data is stored in Identity Verification History
explanation: Identity Verification History logs maintain up to 20,000 total records or 6 months of audit events max.

text: Highlight Canadian customer records on screen without changing page layouts for other users. How to accomplish?
options: Add a rich text component to the Lightning page using conditional visibility
explanation: Rich Text components displayed via Dynamic Component Visibility conditionally alert users to specific record states.

text: Distributors eligible for support based on service contract terms. How to display in Salesforce?
explanation: Entitlement Management tracks service SLAs, support contracts, and milestone verifications.

text: Notify cross-departmental project team members when Project Status changes to Allocated. How to configure?
options: Create public groups for each project team and send email alert to the group
explanation: Public Groups aggregate users across disparate roles/departments to act as email alert recipients.

text: Custom field on Contact changed from Text to Text Area. What tool investigates who made the edit?
explanation: Setup Audit Trail records metadata changes, field data type modifications, and responsible admins.

text: Sales rep needs to add a colleague to Opportunity Team but cannot edit. Which two permissions required?
options: A permission with Edit access on the Account object
A role above the Opportunity owner in the role hierarchy
explanation: Adding opportunity team members requires Edit access on the parent Account and ownership/hierarchy authority over the Opportunity.

text: Relate custom 'Audit' object to Account. Records must persist for 10 years even if Account is deleted. What relationship?
explanation: Lookup relationships preserve child records independently when parent accounts are deleted.

text: Send email reminder 1 week before close date if in Proposal, or immediately if Budget Approved checked. How to build?
options: Create a record-triggered flow with scheduled paths running after save
explanation: Record-triggered flows with Scheduled Paths execute immediate actions alongside date-offset scheduled actions.

text: List Accounts with current year sales and completed activity in last 30 days without opportunity details. What feature?
explanation: Cross-Filters filter parent records based on child object conditions without including child fields in report output.

text: Implementing MFA for Salesforce org security. Which two options are valid MFA factors?
explanation: MFA requires something you know (Password) plus something you have (Authenticator App or physical security key).

text: Reps unable to select newly added keyboard product on opportunities. Which two items to check?
options: Confirm the correct price book is selected on the opportunity
Ensure price book is in company currency
Ensure the product is associated with the correct price book
explanation: Products must be listed as active Price Book Entries inside the specific Price Book assigned to the Opportunity.

text: Review if administrators are making configuration edits directly in production. What item to review?
explanation: Setup Audit Trail tracks all configuration and administrative changes made directly in Setup.

text: Knowledge article documentation needs global organization and access control. What feature to configure?
explanation: Data Categories organize Knowledge articles hierarchically and govern access permissions via Data Category Visibility.

text: Sales reps skipping 'Use Case' field when moving stage to Qualified. What to implement?
options: Create a validation rule and add the Use Case field to Stage Guidance in Path
Make field required on master layout
explanation: Validation Rules block invalid stage transitions, while Path Guidance highlights required fields visually.

text: Exception report showing B2C accounts missing encrypted credit card numbers. How to accomplish?
options: Create a summary report that includes a cross-filter to the Account object with a sub-filter for credit card number equal to null
explanation: Cross-Filters check for missing or null child/field attributes on master records.

text: Track client form submissions (>30 fields) submitted multiple times during sales cycle and compare changes. Which two tools?
explanation: Creating a child custom object stores multiple submissions, and Field History Tracking logs field modifications.

text: Automate updates to 3 fields on Shipment custom object in strict sequential order. How to configure?
options: Create a process with one criteria node and three field updates in the correct order
explanation: Process Builder / Flow executes multiple field actions sequentially within a single action group.

text: User accidentally created duplicate opportunity and cannot delete it. How to troubleshoot?
options: Check user profile permissions on Opportunity object to see if they have Delete permission
explanation: Deleting records requires explicit 'Delete' object permissions on the user's Profile or Permission Sets.

text: Roll-up summary fields on Account for child Invoice object. Which two considerations apply?
options: Roll-up types include COUNT, SUM, and AVG
Roll-up summary fields are created on the master side of a master-detail relationship
Roll-up summary fields prevent conversion to lookup
explanation: Roll-up summary fields live on master objects in master-detail relationships and support COUNT, SUM, MIN, MAX.

text: Email-to-Case creates cases with wrong record type despite settings. What is causing this?
options: The Automated Case User needs permissions to the new record type
explanation: The Automated Case User processes incoming Email-to-Case emails and requires default access to target record types.

text: Report showing all open opportunities and total number of distinct accounts represented. What option to use?
options: The Show Unique Count option on the account name column
explanation: The 'Show Unique Count' column setting calculates distinct account record counts in report summaries.

text: Capture distinct start and end dates for service plans sold on Opportunity Products based on family. What to create?
options: Make a validation rule on the Opportunity Product object to require custom date fields based on product family
explanation: Validation rules on Opportunity Line Items validate field input conditionally per product family.

text: Backup team users need custom Lightning record page view depending on active department. How to configure?
options: Configure one app per department and activate record pages for each app
explanation: Assigning different Lightning Record Pages to specific Lightning Apps tailors UI layout per active app context.

text: Parent Invoice and child Payment custom object. Invoice must display running sum of payments. How to build?
options: Create a master-detail relationship on Payment with a Roll-up Summary field on Invoice
explanation: Roll-Up Summary fields aggregate child field values (SUM) natively over Master-Detail relationships.

text: What prevents a user from syncing a quote with an opportunity?
options: Another quote is already synced with the opportunity and is awaiting approval
explanation: An active sync or pending approval lock on a synced quote prevents syncing a secondary quote.

text: Converting B2C Lead offers only B2B Customer and External Partner record types. How to correct?
options: Build a process that updates the record type field to B2C Customer after conversion
explanation: Post-conversion automated Flows update converted Account/Contact record types dynamically based on Lead attributes.

text: Delete Master-Detail field between Races and Runners without deleting Runners records. What action required first?
options: Change field type to Lookup Relationship
Delete Roll-up Summary field on parent
explanation: Converting Master-Detail to Lookup prevents cascading deletion of child records upon relationship removal.

text: Sales reps present multiple quote configurations to customers. How to maintain accurate opportunity pipeline?
options: Update quote record each time and click sync
Create a new quote record for each product configuration and sync the most likely one back to opportunity
explanation: Multiple Quotes can be created under one Opportunity, with the primary negotiated configuration synced to the Opportunity.

text: Junction object 'Item' links Account and Quota. Account owners change frequently. What grants access to all Item records?
options: Give the account owner Read access to both Account and Quota objects
explanation: Viewing junction object records requires at least Read access on both parent master objects.

text: Distinguish direct contacts from indirect contacts on Account page layout in Contacts to Multiple Accounts. How to configure?
options: Display the related contacts related list and add the Direct field
Display contacts list and add related field
explanation: The 'Related Contacts' list includes the 'Direct' boolean field indicating account-contact relationship type.

text: Tracking wholesale retail pricing vs direct customer pricing for opportunity deals. What to create?
options: Create a new Price Book for the new retail pricing
explanation: Distinct Price Books isolate market-specific product pricing for opportunity selection.

text: East operations team needs access to all accounts and opportunities in East sales region (OWD Private). How to configure?
options: Instruct operations to add themselves to account teams
Utilize territory management to add the operations team to the East territory
explanation: Territory Management grants record access to accounts and opportunities based on defined geographic/regional territories.

text: Renewals team needs to view all Closed Won opportunities while keeping parent accounts private. How to meet requirement?
options: Update OWD on Opportunities to Public Read Only and add them to opportunities team
Permission set with View All on Accounts
New profile with View All on Accounts
Create a public group for renewals team and create a criteria-based sharing rule on Opportunities
explanation: Opportunity criteria sharing or setting Opportunity OWD to Public Read Only permits opportunity access without granting account visibility.

text: Build complex dashboards with supporting charts blending Salesforce data and external shared drive data. What product?
explanation: Tableau CRM (CRM Analytics) ingests, blends, and visualizes large datasets from both internal and external sources.

text: Which object configuration must be done in Object Manager rather than Schema Builder?
options: Add custom fields to page layout
explanation: Adding custom fields to page layouts requires layout editor navigation within Object Manager.

text: Service agent flow deployed to production via Change Set is unavailable to users. What step should admin take?
options: Activate the flow manually after deployment
Include active/inactive flow version in change set
explanation: Flows deployed via change sets land in the target org as inactive and require manual activation.

text: Audit if administrators are utilizing the 'Log In As a User' feature. Where to inspect?
explanation: Setup Audit Trail logs administrative actions, including when admins log in as other users.

text: Link multiple Case records to multiple Outcome records (junction object). Any user who views Case can link. How to configure?
options: Lookup relationship with Read/Write sharing setting
explanation: Lookup relationships with Read/Write sharing permit users with access to parent records to link child records freely.

text: Track SLAs and ensure resolution timelines across consumer/retail cases. What to configure?
options: Set up and configure Entitlement Process to design timelines and track issue resolution
Configure Milestones object on Service Contracts
explanation: Entitlement Processes define SLA enforcement timelines, milestone triggers, and escalation alerts.

text: Automatically create a standard set of related Project Milestones when a Project record is saved. What flow type?
explanation: After-save record-triggered flows create related child records after the parent record has been committed to the database.

text: Compliance team wants to track when a user profile was modified and by whom. What tool to review?
explanation: Setup Audit Trail logs profile modification events, permission changes, and user assignment edits.

text: Setting up Collaborative Forecasts. What consideration applies?
options: A forecast can be either revenue-based or quantity-based
Single org limited to 6 forecast types
explanation: Collaborative Forecasts support forecasting by either dollar Revenue or unit Quantity.

text: Identify accounts missing installed solar monitor assets. What report method to use?
options: Use a Cross Filter with WITHOUT logic
explanation: Cross Filters with 'WITHOUT' logic isolate parent records that lack specified child sub-records.

text: Three reasons to utilize Data Categories in Knowledge base. Choose 3 answers?
options: Data Categories help organize Knowledge base content displayed
Data Categories provide a way to secure access to Knowledge base content
Knowledge articles can be tagged to more than one Data Category
explanation: Data Categories organize Knowledge articles, govern role-based access visibility, and permit multi-tagging per article.

text: Convert installation spreadsheet into custom object and import records simultaneously. What tool?
options: Use Lightning Object Creator to create object and import data
explanation: Lightning Object Creator parses spreadsheets to construct custom objects, fields, and populate initial data.

text: Two considerations before adding Chat to Service Console in Lightning Experience. Choose 2 answers?
options: Chat unavailable in Lightning if using Omni-Channel
Chat must be routed with Omni-Channel in Lightning Experience
Chat can only be added to Console navigation Lightning apps
explanation: In Lightning Experience, Chat routing requires Omni-Channel integration and renders within Console Navigation apps.

text: Import Order and Order Item data from ERP maintaining relationships in Salesforce. Which two load steps?
options: Use an Insert operation to load data
Map an External ID data value to the object
explanation: Inserting master Orders first and linking child Order Items using External ID lookup mapping retains relational integrity.

text: Filter criteria selection for listing reports. Which three field types are valid filter criteria?
options: A phone field providing full phone number
A number field designating square footage
explanation: Phone fields, Number fields, and Picklist fields can be directly evaluated in report filter criteria.

text: Consideration before implementing Salesforce Shield Platform Encryption. What to keep in mind?
options: Einstein Lead Scoring active on encrypted fields
Paused flows can cause data to be saved in an unencrypted state
explanation: Paused flow interviews serialize temporary context state data unencrypted in database storage.

text: Ensure Salesforce session disconnects after 10 minutes of inactivity to prevent unattended device attacks. What setting?
explanation: Enabling 'Force logout on session timeout' terminates inactive user sessions immediately upon timeout expiration.

text: Show button on Account page to start escalation process only when Account has >5 open opportunities over $10k. Which two items?
explanation: Formula / Roll-Up fields calculate the threshold, and Component Visibility filters render UI components dynamically.

text: Dashboard filter on Account Owner causes missing records on Opportunity components. How to resolve?
options: On the Opportunity components, change the equivalent field
explanation: Setting the 'Equivalent Field' in dashboard component settings maps dashboard filter values properly across objects.

text: Identify cause of intermittent 'Apex CPU time limit exceeded' errors when closing opportunities. Recommended method?
explanation: Enabling Debug Logs captures Apex CPU execution time consumed by triggers, flows, and validation rules.

text: Reassign open leads >60 days old using assignment rules. Which two tools execute lead update with assignment rules?
explanation: Dataloader.io and Data Loader / Bulk API support triggering active Lead Assignment Rules during update operations.

text: Create 10 separate developer environments with identical metadata and data from an existing sandbox. What action?
options: Use clone a sandbox option from existing sandbox
explanation: Cloning an existing sandbox duplicates both metadata configuration and sample data directly into new sandboxes.

text: Report showing if customer refers to new 'Alpha Shoe' line in Case Subject field. How to modify report?
options: Include a contains filter on Subject
explanation: Adding a 'Subject CONTAINS Alpha Shoe' report filter isolates matching case subjects.

text: Monitor and detect brute-force password attacks against Salesforce org logins. Where to look?
explanation: Login Forensics analyzes login request velocity, failure spikes, and brute-force intrusion anomalies.

text: Financial info on Accounts stored in custom object. Only Finance team should access related records. What field type?
explanation: Master-Detail relationships allow tight security inheritance and restricted visibility controls via parent rules.

text: Customer government ID numbers must be uneditable and masked except last 2 digits. Which two configurations?
explanation: Shield Platform Encryption paired with Field Encryption Policies enforces data masking rules and encryption at rest.

text: Require Phone field on Contact if Title is 'CEO'. What formula in Error Condition Formula of Validation Rule?
explanation: Validation rules evaluate to TRUE to fire errors; Title = 'CEO' && ISBLANK(Phone) triggers error when CEO phone is blank.

text: Contacts to Multiple Accounts enabled. Rep cannot remove primary account from contact. Why?
options: A primary Account relationship is required on a Contact regardless of page layout settings
explanation: Salesforce enforces a mandatory Direct Primary Account relationship for all Contact records.

text: Finance team members (under Finance Director role) need access to all Closed Won opportunities (OWD Private). Which two options?
options: Share with roles and subordinates of the finance director role
Owner-based sharing rule where won = true
Create a criteria-based sharing rule where the won field = true
Select all opportunities owned by sales manager
explanation: Criteria-based sharing rules sharing IsWon = True opportunities with the Finance Director Role & Subordinates satisfy access.

text: User cannot find Location custom object in Data Loader during load. Which two reasons explain why?
options: The label of Location may have been changed
Data Loader only for standard objects
The user's profile needs create access to Location
explanation: Data Loader lists objects by Object Label (which may differ from API name) and suppresses objects where the user lacks Create permissions.

text: Limit Amount field FLS on Opportunity across custom profiles in production. How to deploy from sandbox?
options: Deploy a change set from sandbox to production including the Amount field with all custom profiles
explanation: Deploying Change Sets containing both the target field and modified Profiles updates Field-Level Security settings in target orgs.

text: Before trigger saving original record version to external database fails while fast field update flow succeeds. Why?
options: The code could be trying to create duplicates in the archive when it is unable to
explanation: Unhandled Apex exception errors in external callout or archiving code cause trigger failures.

text: Email Case Owner when specific fields are updated using email parsing tool. What automation tool?
explanation: After-Save record-triggered flows evaluate committed record updates and dispatch email notifications.

text: Restrict Government ID field on custom object from Sales profile except select 'Institutional Team' users. How to accommodate?
options: Create a permission set with Read access to the field and assign to Institutional Team
Mark field Read Only on profile
explanation: Restricting baseline field FLS on Profile and granting access via Permission Sets enforces secure granular visibility.

text: Customers report missing status update emails sent from flow. Where to investigate?
explanation: Email Logs detail single and mass email delivery status, recipient addresses, and system delivery failures.

text: Campaign Members object unavailable in Data Import Wizard. Why?
options: The Campaign Member option is only available for Update
explanation: Data Import Wizard permits updating existing Campaign Members but requires other tools or campaign UI for mass creation.

text: Display aggregate count of Equipment items on Room master record. How to accomplish?
options: Create a roll-up summary field on Room
explanation: Roll-Up Summary fields on parent master objects compute aggregate counts of child detail records natively.

text: Account, Product, and related Review junction records deleted accidentally. How to restore Review records?
options: Restore both the Account and Product master records from the Recycle Bin
explanation: Restoring deleted junction detail records requires restoring both associated master parent records from the Recycle Bin.

text: Sales rep selected wrong price book on opportunity. How to change price book?
options: The change can be made through the desktop site
explanation: Price Books can be changed on Opportunity desktop record pages after deleting existing line items.

text: Changing master-detail relationship to lookup between Shipments and Opportunity. How to deploy to production?
options: Add the components to an outbound change set and deploy it to production
explanation: Outbound Change Sets transport modified custom field relationship definitions from sandbox to production orgs.

text: Correct spelling error in displayed text within a Lightning Web Component. Recommended tool?
explanation: VS Code with Salesforce Extensions is the standard IDE for editing and deploying Lightning Web Components.

text: Report showing Accounts alongside open Case records. What report type format?
explanation: Joined Reports combine multiple report blocks (e.g. Accounts and Cases) onto a unified report layout.

text: Audit information on Accounts must be recorded in custom Audit object, preserved 10 years, accessible only to Audit team. What relationship?
explanation: Lookup relationships allow independent record retention and custom security sharing rules separate from parent Accounts.

text: Small subset of users with different roles/profiles need 'View All Data' for compliance. How to grant?
options: Create a permission set with the View All Data permission for the subset of users
explanation: Permission Sets grant system permissions like 'View All Data' to selective cross-functional users without changing profiles.

text: Replaced case workflow rules with before-save flow. Routing behavior changed. What caused the change?
options: Multiple automation tools have been used and the automation is executed in a different order
explanation: Consolidating or mixing multiple automation tools alters execution order dynamics across workflow and flow engines.
